caption: The drawing depicts a single architectural pedestal with a square base and top, rendered in a reddish-brown, marble-like color with lighter and darker variations suggesting a stone texture. The pedestal features concave, inward-curving sides that transition into a large, circular medallion at the center of the visible face, which contains a carved rosette or floral motif. The base of the pedestal consists of several stepped layers, also in reddish-brown, and the top is depicted as a flat, rectangular surface with fine lines that suggest stone slabs. There is a visible shadow on the left side beneath the base, and the pedestal is centered on an otherwise undecorated, off-white background. The artist's signature, "RAYMOND F. HALE," appears to the lower right of the pedestal.
title: Stand for Baptismal Font
